versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the On-Demand Expert Team skill.
- Instantly designs and spins up a temporary expert team to execute tasks end-to-end, releasing the team upon delivery.
- Generates role prompts on-the-fly and injects them inline, without producing a series of prompt files.
- Features dynamic team composition, SOP stage orchestration, quality gates, and delivery integration.
- Supports multiple execution modes (team tools, sub-agent, single session) and adheres to strict domain-specific protocols.
- Includes comprehensive documentation with domain taxonomy, templates, validation scripts, and reference exemplars.
